name: March from Velis Vel
oracle_text:
Choose a nonbasic land type. Each land you control of that type becomes a copy of target creature you control until end of turn and gains haste until end of turn.
Flashback {4}{U} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)
blocked_sentences: Choose a nonbasic land type. Each land you control of that type becomes a copy of target creature you control until end of turn and gains haste until end of turn.

needs.what: a `choose_type` axis `of: "nonbasic_land_type"` offering the nonbasic land types (Cave, Desert, Gate, Lair, Locus, Mine, Power-Plant, Sphere, Tower, Urza's, ...), stored on the resolving spell, plus a selector read-back (e.g. `subtypes: [{"chosen_land_type_of": "self"}]`) so `become_copy`'s `objects` can be 'each land you control of the chosen type'
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `choose_type` only has the creature_type (surveyed, writes chosen_type), permanent_type and card_type (write chosen_card_type) axes; none offers land subtypes, and the only subtype read-back is `chosen_type_of: self`, which holds a creature type. `become_copy` (with `copying` targeting a creature you control) and `grant_keyword` haste cover the rest, and Flashback is a card-level cost key
